content.text: Ongoing mgmt (AVRT and/or pre-excited AF, ablation ⍉an option): oral flecainide or propafenone = reasonable if ⍉struct or ischemic Hdz; oral dofetilide or sotalol may be reasonable.
Unlike flecainide and propafenone, sotalol and dofetilide can be used w struct Hdz or CAD.
